name: Vdeal System Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, Vdeal System Ltd manufactures and trades electrical control panel boards[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
VDSL is an ISO 9001:2008 Certified company, registered under NSIC, DIC, and MSME. It is a solution provider in the field of Electrical Panels, Industrial Automation, Process Instrumentation & Industrial IoT (I-4). The company is also a Premium System Integrator

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 34.6%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 177 days.
Working capital days have increased from 107 days to 256 days
